name: search-failover
description: Aggregated web search with automatic failover: Bocha/Tavily/Brave/Exa/DuckDuckGo by default, opt-in Zhipu/Qianfan/Serper. Works with zero API keys (DuckDuckGo fallback).

BOCHA_API_KEY.title: Bocha API key
BOCHA_API_KEY.description: Bocha (bochaai.com) API key. Optional — omit if you don't use Bocha.

ZHIPU_API_KEY.title: Zhipu API key
ZHIPU_API_KEY.description: Zhipu web-search API key. Opt-in provider — also needs enabled:true in search-failover.json.

QIANFAN_API_KEY.title: Baidu Qianfan API key
QIANFAN_API_KEY.description: Baidu Qianfan API key. Opt-in provider — also needs enabled:true in search-failover.json.

SERPER_API_KEY.title: Serper API key
SERPER_API_KEY.description: Serper.dev API key. Opt-in provider — also needs enabled:true in search-failover.json.

CONFIG_PATH.title: Config file path
CONFIG_PATH.description: Absolute path to search-failover.json (optional; enables opt-in providers, priority and quota tuning). Leave empty for built-in defaults.
